- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended books and magazines for weathering techniques:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Weathering for Model Ship Builders" by David Griffith: Comprehensive guide to weathering techniques.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Model Ship Building: A Guide to Building and Finishing Model Ships" by Donald McNarry-Taylor: Covers various aspects of model ship building.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Scale Ship Modeler magazine: Features articles on weathering techniques.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Model Shipwrights magazine: Dedicated to model ship building with articles on weathering.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for weathering techniques:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Start with reference images of real ships.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Practice on a test piece before applying to the model.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Use a variety of materials like oil paints, acrylics, enamels, and pigments.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Start with light applications and build up gradually.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Join online communities for feedback and learning.
